history.summary: 7 Job×Lv1..50=350 rows frozen. Existing direct equipment coefficients reused; shield Block uses Human-approved ability-dependent formula; Bow+Quiver aggregated. Beast/body-type equipment restrictions deferred.

evidence_manifest.purpose: Frozen equipment-capable humanoid Monster Core authority
evidence_manifest.scope: 7 Current basic Jobs × Level 1..50; 350 rows; no Player Equipment/iLv; non-humanoid equipment restrictions excluded
evidence_manifest.this_project_role: Formal numeric authority for equipment-capable humanoid Monster Core; non-humanoid/body-type equipment restrictions are excluded.

authority_boundary.base_stats: MonsterStat = Level * expected_gain_per_level. Player initial ALL10 is not added.
authority_boundary.equipment_model: Monster combat value = Monster corresponding ability stat * existing equipment category coefficient. Player Equipment item/Candidate/Contribution and iLv are not used.
authority_boundary.bow_quiver: Bow and Quiver non-critical coefficients are summed. Bow=1 Strike, Quiver=0 Strike, Critical=Bow only (5%).
authority_boundary.armor: HP=VIT*armor.vit, MP=MND*armor.mnd, Evasion=AGI*armor.agi using existing 重装/軽装/ローブ coefficients.
authority_boundary.defense: No new raw Defense coefficient is invented. Direct defense field remains 0 in this core; defensive equipment performance is represented by HP/Evasion/Block and is normalized later by Core Enemy Budget work.
authority_boundary.tier_dependency: None. No item level or equipment tier is used.
authority_boundary.body_type_exclusion: Do not apply this equipment profile to monsters whose body type cannot equip the relevant weapon/shield/armor (e.g. beast-type shield-ineligible monsters). That layer is deferred to TASK-BAL-072-CORR-002.
